question: How can the existing primary Q4a descriptive figure be displayed with clear legend/title separation while preserving every frozen measured value and interpretation limit?
decision: Replace only the displayed primary figure with an independently frozen render-only spacing correction; preserve all original v2 outputs and its sensitivity figure.
strongest_rival: A layout correction could inadvertently change selected cases, plotted values, labels or denominator interpretation; exact source selection and visual/value checks address this presentation risk.
discriminator: Same eight primary cases and 16 plotted RNA/fragment differences, same colors/labels/axis extent and full caption; dedicated legend band and lowered axes only.
exposure_record: All v2 outcomes and figures are exposed. Originating review requested this precise layout correction after inspecting both actual PNGs; the sensitivity figure passed. The source table and v2 receipt are hash-bound. No raw-source reanalysis or outcome selection is performed.
biological_unit: Unchanged finite-library v2 summary; this render creates no biological observations or units.
nesting_and_overlap: All v2 shared-CTRL, barcode nesting and RNA reuse remain. Only the existing primary eight paired cases are rendered; no new measurements.
population_and_selection: Exactly v2 strand_records, all paired barcodes, pooled, tss_2kb_union for four fixed loci and two contrasts. No QC or population change.
contrast: Unchanged v2 LGR5-minus-CTRL and KRT20-minus-CTRL RNA/fragment differences for Cd74, Tiam1, Cd83 and Ciita.
endpoint: Existing 16 plotted log2(CPM+1) differences copied from the frozen v2 table; no new endpoint. Only PNG/SVG primary figure outputs.
methods: Read saved paired_contrasts.csv, require all 128 source rows defined and exactly eight unique primary cases. Preserve numeric values, colors, labels and original extent derived from the same source table. Increase canvas height, reserve a dedicated legend row, lower axes. Use unchanged first-generation SVG-save helper. Inspect actual PNG and SVG label positions after rendering.
missingness_and_exclusions: No case exclusion or imputation. Unexpected source row count/status/primary mapping stops rendering.
multiplicity: No additional comparison or analysis: only redisplay the existing eight primary paired cases. All 128 original rows and 64 deltas remain unchanged.
precision_basis: Finite deposited-library description with unknown independent biological units; no population precision claim or invented effect margin.
interpretation_limit: All v2 finite-library/source-record/region/genotype/state/independence limits remain. Neither counting definition certifies physical molecules. This render creates no biological acceptance or equivalence claim.
stop_rule: Hash mismatch, nonfresh output directory, unexpected source cases/status or missing primary cases stops rendering. Preserve previous images; corrections use a new artifact path and receipt.
amendment_reason: Originating visual review found primary legend/title crowding. Render-only prospective correction from existing v2 contrasts, with no biological rerun or value change.
